trials.hypothesis: A dollar-neutral cross-sectional equity portfolio can earn a stable premium by combining medium-term momentum, short-term reversal, low volatility, and proximity to 52-week highs. Monthly rebalancing keeps turnover low. Liquidity filtering and equal weights within long and short legs control risk, while the 2% position cap and gross exposure below 1.0 satisfy portfolio constraints.

The prior combined factor lost money largely because 12-month momentum dominated the score while short-horizon reversal was underweighted. I will test a weekly-rebalanced, dollar-neutral short-horizon reversal portfolio with a defensive low-volatility tilt: buy liquid stocks with weak 5- and 21-day returns and low realized volatility, and short liquid stocks with strong recent returns and high volatility. Using the most recent Friday close as the signal date keeps turnover lower and aligns with next-open execution, while equal weights and the 2% cap satisfy gross, net and position constraints.

Round-1 evidence shows the reversal signal has genuine but fragile value: it only turned positive out-of-sample and lost money in train, with ~0.30 daily turnover implying ~4%/yr of pure transaction-cost drag. The fix is not a new factor family but lower-churn harvesting of the same short-horizon reversal premium. Instead of a single noisy 5-day reversal reading, I average percentile ranks of reversal computed at four overlapping end-points (offset 0, 5, 10, 15 sessions), which makes basket membership far stickier and adds a 3-month reversal term for names whose over-extension is slower to decay, plus a mild low-volatility tilt to avoid reversal traps in the noisiest names. Signals are frozen at the last Friday close so weights are constant within a week, and the ranking is only recomputed weekly. Liquidity and eligibility screens remain. Within each leg of 50 names I tilt capital toward the most extreme scores on a smooth ramp whose maximum stays under the 2% cap, keeping gross 0.98 and exactly dollar-neutral. The expected outcome is a materially lower turnover-driven cost while retaining the reversal alpha, giving a better net Sharpe than either prior round.

trials.hypothesis: The prior weekly short-horizon reversal strategy had positive gross returns but was consumed by roughly 0.30 daily turnover and transaction costs. The revised experiment keeps the reversal premise but harvests it more slowly: rebalance only once per month using the last completed month-end close, rank stocks on 21-day and 63-day reversal plus a low-volatility tilt, and hold equal-weighted dollar-neutral long/short baskets until the next month-end signal. Slower formation windows and monthly holding should cut turnover by roughly an order of magnitude while retaining the reversal premium. Liquidity and eligibility screens remain, and position sizing respects the 2% cap, gross limit and net tolerance.

Round-1 weekly 5/21 reversal had positive gross alpha in train but was consumed by roughly 0.30 daily turnover; round-3 monthly 21/63 reversal cut turnover to roughly 0.09 and had positive validation, but its train gross return was negative. The evidence points to the short-horizon reversal terms, especially 5- and 10-day, being the part that worked in train, while 21/63 alone did not. I will test a monthly-rebalanced composite that keeps short-horizon reversal at the core, blends in 21-day and a smaller 63-day term for stability, and adds a low-volatility tilt to avoid reversal traps. Signals are frozen at the last completed month-end and held until the next month-end, so turnover remains near the round-3 monthly level while the signal mix retains the round-1 short-horizon alpha. Equal-weighted dollar-neutral 50/50 baskets, liquidity and eligibility screens, and the 2% position cap keep all constraints satisfied.

Across the three completed experiments the medium-horizon, monthly-rebalanced reversal book (round 3: 21/63-day reversal plus a low-volatility tilt, ~0.09 daily turnover) is the only configuration that was clearly positive out-of-sample (validation Sharpe 0.43), while the two variants that leaned harder on very short (5/10-day) reversal were worse in both train (-0.37) and validation (0.24). That inverts the round-4 premise: sub-monthly reversal added noise and cost, not alpha. I therefore keep the proven core (monthly decision from the last month boundary, 50/50 dollar-neutral equal-weight baskets, liquidity and eligibility screens, 2% cap, gross ~0.98) and make two principled revisions rather than a wholesale change. First, add a slower 126-day reversal term, which decays gradually and is far less contaminated by bid-ask bounce, so the reversal alpha is spread over horizons that historically persist. Second, introduce a small 12-1 momentum term (return from t-252 to t-21) as a diversifier: pure reversal is an implicit bet against trending markets, which is exactly the 2016-2021 train regime in which it lost, and short-cross-sectional-reversal and 12-1 momentum have historically low/negative correlation. Weights are shrunk so reversal still dominates (~65% of the composite), the low-volatility tilt is retained to avoid reversal traps, and momentum is neutralized (rank 0.5) for names without a full 12-month history so new listings are still scored on reversal. The goal is a regime-robust composite that keeps round-3's low turnover and positive validation while leaning less hard on any single anomaly.

Across rounds 1-5, the only clearly positive out-of-sample configuration was the monthly, medium-horizon reversal book (round 3: 21/63-day reversal plus low-volatility tilt, ~0.09 daily turnover, validation Sharpe 0.43), while every attempt to inject faster 5/10-day reversal or 12-1 momentum degraded results. All variants, however, shared a negative train Sharpe in 2016-2021. A common explanation is that cross-sectional reversal pays when return dispersion across names is high (idiosyncratic moves mean-revert) and bleeds when dispersion is compressed and a common trend dominates, which describes much of 2016-2021. Rather than change the signal, I keep the proven round-3 core exactly (monthly decisions at the last completed month boundary, 21/63-day reversal ranks plus low-volatility rank, liquidity and eligibility screens, 50/50 dollar-neutral equal-weight baskets, 2% cap, gross <= 0.98) and add a point-in-time regime overlay: measure the trailing 21-day mean of daily cross-sectional return dispersion and its percentile within the last ~252 sessions, then scale gross exposure smoothly between 0.4x and 1.0x. This is squarely a risk-allocation change, not a new alpha claim: it shrinks the book when the anomaly's payoff environment is weakest, should dampen the 2016-2021 drawdown, and lets the book run at full size in high-dispersion periods like the validation window and its aftermath.

Six rounds of evidence share one pattern: raw cross-sectional reversal works in the validation window but loses in 2016-2021. The most likely mechanism is not that reversal is dead, but that the short leg (recent winners) was persistently hurt by a strong momentum/beta trend, while the long leg (recent losers) was dominated by high-beta names that kept falling, so raw return reversal conflated idiosyncratic mean-reversion with market/beta exposure. The fix is not a new alpha claim but a cleaner signal: residual reversal. I estimate each name's market beta over a trailing 150 sessions against an equal-weighted market proxy, subtract beta times the market return, and measure the reversal of the cumulative residual over 21, 63 and 126 sessions. This isolates the part of past return that is idiosyncratic and should mean-revert, and sharply reduces the book's implicit anti-momentum/beta bet that drove the train drawdown. I keep the well-evidenced structural elements from earlier rounds: monthly decisions at the last completed month-end (turnover ~0.06-0.09), 50/50 dollar-neutral equal-weight baskets, liquidity and eligibility screens, the low-volatility rank to avoid reversal traps, the 2% position cap, and the cross-sectional dispersion regime overlay that improved validation Sharpe (0.41) and cut max drawdown. One targeted addition addresses the short leg directly: when forming the short basket, names in the top decile of 12-1 momentum are skipped, because momentum-crash names are exactly the ones that refused to mean-revert during the train period. If the residual construction is right, train should improve materially while the validation gains from round 6 are retained.

Round 7 returned exactly zero active days in both train and validation, which is a mechanical failure rather than an economic result: the market-beta projection was formed with `mkt.mul(beta)` where `mkt` is indexed by dates and `beta` by tickers, so pandas aligned on the union of two label spaces and produced an all-NaN projection; every residual reversal score became NaN, the validity filter emptied the cross-section, and the function returned zeros. The economic premise of round 7 is still the best-supported explanation of six rounds of evidence: the persistent train-period loss of raw reversal is largely a disguised anti-beta / anti-momentum bet, because recent losers in 2016-2021 were high-beta names that kept falling while recent winners kept winning. I therefore re-implement the same residual-reversal idea with correct, fully vectorised numpy numerics (outer product of the NaN-aware equal-weighted market return and per-name trailing 150-day betas, clipped to [0.2, 3.0] and defaulted to 1.0 when coverage is thin), keep the proven structural core from round 6 (monthly decisions at the last completed month-end, liquidity and eligibility screens, 50/50 dollar-neutral equal-weight baskets, low-volatility rank as a reversal-trap guard, 2% cap, dispersion regime overlay smoothing gross between 0.45x and 1.0x), and add two robustness safeguards so a numerical failure can never again produce a dead book: residual scores cascade to shorter horizons and, if fewer than 24 names survive with residual data, the score falls back to plain price reversal for that month. Shorts additionally skip top-decile 12-1 momentum names, the specific cohort that refused to mean-revert in train.

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd


def _zeros(tickers):
    return pd.Series(0.0, index=pd.Index(tickers), dtype=float)


def generate_weights(history, universe):
    tickers = pd.Index(universe)
    if len(tickers) == 0:
        return pd.Series(dtype=float)

    adj_full = history.get('adjusted_close')
    if adj_full is None:
        adj_full = history.get('close')
    if adj_full is None or len(adj_full.index) == 0:
        return _zeros(tickers)

    adj = adj_full.reindex(columns=tickers)
    dates = adj.index
    if len(dates) < 130:
        return _zeros(tickers)

    yv = np.asarray(dates.year) * 12 + np.asarray(dates.month)
    if len(yv) >= 2:
        breaks = np.where(yv[1:] != yv[:-1])[0]
    else:
        breaks = np.array([], dtype=int)
    sig_idx = int(breaks[-1]) if len(breaks) > 0 else len(dates) - 1

    start_idx = max(0, sig_idx - 300)
    sub = adj.iloc[start_idx:sig_idx + 1].ffill(limit=5)
    sub = sub.where(sub > 0)
    n = len(sub)
    if n < 45:
        return _zeros(tickers)

    elig = history.get('eligible')
    sig_ok = sub.iloc[-1].notna()
    latest_ok = adj.iloc[-1].notna()
    if elig is not None:
        try:
            e = elig.reindex(index=dates, columns=tickers)
            sig_ok = sig_ok & e.iloc[sig_idx].fillna(False).astype(bool)
            latest_ok = latest_ok & e.iloc[-1].fillna(False).astype(bool)
        except Exception:
            pass

    liq_ok = pd.Series(True, index=tickers, dtype=bool)
    vol_df = history.get('volume')
    close_df = history.get('close')
    if vol_df is not None and close_df is not None:
        try:
            v = vol_df.reindex(index=dates, columns=tickers).iloc[start_idx:sig_idx + 1]
            c = close_df.reindex(index=dates, columns=tickers).iloc[start_idx:sig_idx + 1]
            liq = (c * v).tail(60).median()
            liq_rank = liq.rank(pct=True, na_option='keep')
            liq_ok = liq.notna() & (liq > 0) & (liq_rank >= 0.20)
        except Exception:
            pass

    last = sub.iloc[-1]
    rets = sub.pct_change(fill_method=None)
    R = rets.values.astype(float)
    mcols = len(tickers)
    if R.ndim != 2 or R.shape[1] != mcols or R.shape[0] < 30:
        return _zeros(tickers)

    # NaN-aware equal-weighted market return per session
    with np.errstate(invalid='ignore'):
        mk = np.nanmean(R, axis=1)
    mk = np.where(np.isfinite(mk), mk, 0.0)

    # trailing betas vs equal-weighted market (vectorised, NaN-masked)
    w = int(min(150, R.shape[0]))
    Wb = R[-w:]
    mb = mk[-w:]
    mask = np.isfinite(Wb) & np.isfinite(mb)[:, None]
    cnt = mask.sum(axis=0)
    cnts = np.maximum(cnt, 1)
    Wf = np.where(mask, Wb, 0.0)
    mf = np.where(mask, mb[:, None], 0.0)
    wmean = Wf.sum(axis=0) / cnts
    mmean = mf.sum(axis=0) / cnts
    dm = mf - mmean[None, :]
    dw = Wf - wmean[None, :]
    den = (dm * dm).sum(axis=0)
    num = (dm * dw).sum(axis=0)
    beta = np.where(den > 1e-12, num / np.where(den > 1e-12, den, 1.0), 1.0)
    beta = np.where((cnt >= 50) & np.isfinite(beta), beta, 1.0)
    beta = np.clip(beta, 0.2, 3.0)

    resid = R - mk[:, None] * beta[None, :]

    def _rsum(k, minc):
        if resid.shape[0] < k:
            return np.full(mcols, np.nan)
        blk = resid[-k:]
        good = np.isfinite(blk)
        s = np.where(good, blk, 0.0).sum(axis=0)
        c = good.sum(axis=0)
        return np.where(c >= minc, s, np.nan)

    rev21 = pd.Series(-_rsum(21, 10), index=tickers, dtype=float)
    rev63 = pd.Series(-_rsum(63, 30), index=tickers, dtype=float)
    rev126 = pd.Series(-_rsum(126, 60), index=tickers, dtype=float)

    vola = pd.Series(np.nan, index=tickers, dtype=float)
    try:
        vola = rets.tail(120).std(skipna=True) * np.sqrt(252.0)
        vola = vola.reindex(tickers)
    except Exception:
        vola = pd.Series(np.nan, index=tickers, dtype=float)
    qvol = (-vola).rank(pct=True, na_option='keep')

    mom = pd.Series(np.nan, index=tickers, dtype=float)
    if n >= 252:
        mom = sub.iloc[-21] / sub.iloc[-252] - 1.0
    qmom = mom.rank(pct=True, na_option='keep')

    def _composite(a21, a63, a126):
        q21 = a21.rank(pct=True, na_option='keep')
        q63 = a63.rank(pct=True, na_option='keep')
        q126 = a126.rank(pct=True, na_option='keep')
        q126 = q126.fillna(q63).fillna(q21)
        q63 = q63.fillna(q21)
        return q21, q63, q126

    q21, q63, q126 = _composite(rev21, rev63, rev126)
    score = 0.45 * q21 + 0.30 * q63 + 0.10 * q126 + 0.15 * qvol

    base_valid = sig_ok & latest_ok & liq_ok & qvol.notna() & last.notna()
    valid = base_valid & q21.notna() & q63.notna()
    score = score[valid].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).dropna()

    if len(score) < 24:
        # fallback: plain price reversal (round-6 core) if residual data is thin
        p21 = pd.Series(np.nan, index=tickers, dtype=float)
        p63 = pd.Series(np.nan, index=tickers, dtype=float)
        if n >= 22:
            p21 = -(last / sub.iloc[-22] - 1.0)
        if n >= 64:
            p63 = -(last / sub.iloc[-64] - 1.0)
        p63 = p63.fillna(p21)
        b21, b63, b126 = _composite(p21, p63, p21)
        score2 = 0.55 * b21 + 0.30 * b63 + 0.15 * qvol
        valid2 = base_valid & b21.notna() & b63.notna()
        score = score2[valid2].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).dropna()

    if len(score) < 20:
        return _zeros(tickers)

    disp_scale = 1.0
    try:
        with np.errstate(invalid='ignore'):
            cs = pd.Series(np.nanstd(R, axis=1), index=rets.index).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).dropna()
        if len(cs) >= 80:
            smooth = cs.rolling(21, min_periods=10).mean().dropna()
            if len(smooth) >= 40:
                cur = float(smooth.iloc[-1])
                window = smooth.tail(int(min(252, len(smooth))))
                pct = float((window.values <= cur).mean())
                disp_scale = 0.45 + 0.55 * max(0.0, min(1.0, pct))
    except Exception:
        disp_scale = 1.0

    n_side = int(min(50, len(score) // 2))
    if n_side < 12:
        return _zeros(tickers)

    ranked = score.sort_values(ascending=False)
    longs = list(ranked.index[:n_side])

    short_pool = list(ranked.index[n_side:])
    if len(short_pool) > n_side:
        try:
            mslice = qmom.reindex(short_pool)
            filtered = [
                t for t in short_pool
                if not (pd.notna(mslice.loc[t]) and float(mslice.loc[t]) > 0.90)
            ]
            if len(filtered) >= n_side:
                short_pool = filtered
        except Exception:
            pass
    shorts = short_pool[-n_side:]

    per_side = min(0.49, 0.02 * n_side) * disp_scale
    wgt = per_side / float(n_side)

    weights = pd.Series(0.0, index=tickers, dtype=float)
    weights.loc[longs] = wgt
    weights.loc[shorts] = -wgt

    weights = weights.clip(-0.02, 0.02)
    weights = weights.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], 0.0).fillna(0.0)
    return weights.reindex(tickers).fillna(0.0)

trials.hypothesis: Rounds 6-8 isolate the real problem cleanly: the reversal book's 2016-2021 loss is mostly a disguised net beta / anti-momentum exposure (recent losers were high-beta names that kept falling), not a dead anomaly. Round 8's residualization fixed part of it (train Sharpe -0.28 -> -0.17) but cost validation performance (0.41 -> 0.31), and its market-risk projection still leaves the two baskets unbalanced in beta because each side is selected independently. The next step is therefore to fix the exposure at the portfolio level instead of only at the signal level: keep the reversal alpha that demonstrably worked in validation (raw price reversal, monthly decisions, ~0.06-0.07 daily turnover) as the dominant input, add a smaller residual-reversal component for robustness, scale each name's past move by its own volatility so the signal is not dominated by the highest-volatility losers, and then select the short basket from the worst-score pool to match the beta profile of the long basket name-by-name. This keeps quality (shorts still come only from the bottom of the score distribution) while removing the net beta bet that produced the train drawdown, so train should keep improving without giving back validation gains. All proven structural elements are retained: month-end decisions, eligibility and liquidity screens, 50/50 dollar-neutral equal-weight baskets, low-volatility rank as a reversal-trap guard, 2% position cap, gross <= 0.98, and the cross-sectional dispersion overlay scaling gross between 0.45x and 1.0x.

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd


def _zeros(tickers):
    return pd.Series(0.0, index=pd.Index(tickers), dtype=float)


def _rsum(M, k, minc):
    m = M.shape[1]
    if M.shape[0] < k:
        return np.full(m, np.nan)
    blk = M[-k:]
    good = np.isfinite(blk)
    s = np.where(good, blk, 0.0).sum(axis=0)
    c = good.sum(axis=0)
    return np.where(c >= minc, s, np.nan)


def generate_weights(history, universe):
    tickers = pd.Index(universe)
    if len(tickers) == 0:
        return pd.Series(dtype=float)

    adj = history.get('adjusted_close')
    if adj is None:
        adj = history.get('close')
    if adj is None or len(adj.index) == 0:
        return _zeros(tickers)

    adj = adj.reindex(columns=tickers)
    dates = adj.index
    if len(dates) < 130:
        return _zeros(tickers)

    yv = np.asarray(dates.year) * 12 + np.asarray(dates.month)
    if len(yv) >= 2:
        brk = np.where(yv[1:] != yv[:-1])[0]
    else:
        brk = np.array([], dtype=int)
    sig_idx = int(brk[-1]) if len(brk) > 0 else len(dates) - 1

    start_idx = max(0, sig_idx - 300)
    sub = adj.iloc[start_idx:sig_idx + 1].ffill(limit=5)
    sub = sub.where(sub > 0)
    n = len(sub)
    if n < 45:
        return _zeros(tickers)

    elig = history.get('eligible')
    sig_ok = sub.iloc[-1].notna()
    latest_ok = adj.iloc[-1].notna()
    if elig is not None:
        try:
            e = elig.reindex(index=dates, columns=tickers)
            sig_ok = sig_ok & e.iloc[sig_idx].fillna(False).astype(bool)
            latest_ok = latest_ok & e.iloc[-1].fillna(False).astype(bool)
        except Exception:
            pass

    liq_ok = pd.Series(True, index=tickers, dtype=bool)
    vol_df = history.get('volume')
    close_df = history.get('close')
    if vol_df is not None and close_df is not None:
        try:
            v = vol_df.reindex(index=dates, columns=tickers).iloc[start_idx:sig_idx + 1]
            c = close_df.reindex(index=dates, columns=tickers).iloc[start_idx:sig_idx + 1]
            liq = (c * v).tail(60).median()
            lr = liq.rank(pct=True, na_option='keep')
            liq_ok = liq.notna() & (liq > 0) & (lr >= 0.20)
        except Exception:
            pass

    last = sub.iloc[-1]
    rets = sub.pct_change(fill_method=None)
    R = rets.values.astype(float)
    m = len(tickers)
    if R.ndim != 2 or R.shape[1] != m or R.shape[0] < 30:
        return _zeros(tickers)

    with np.errstate(invalid='ignore'):
        mk = np.nanmean(R, axis=1)
    mk = np.where(np.isfinite(mk), mk, 0.0)

    # ---- trailing betas vs equal-weighted market (NaN-masked, vectorised) ----
    wlen = int(min(150, R.shape[0]))
    Wb = R[-wlen:]
    mb = mk[-wlen:]
    mask = np.isfinite(Wb) & np.isfinite(mb)[:, None]
    cnt = mask.sum(axis=0)
    cnts = np.maximum(cnt, 1)
    Wf = np.where(mask, Wb, 0.0)
    mf = np.where(mask, mb[:, None], 0.0)
    wmean = Wf.sum(axis=0) / cnts
    mmean = mf.sum(axis=0) / cnts
    dm = mf - mmean[None, :]
    dw = Wf - wmean[None, :]
    den = (dm * dm).sum(axis=0)
    num = (dm * dw).sum(axis=0)
    beta = np.where(den > 1e-12, num / np.where(den > 1e-12, den, 1.0), 1.0)
    beta = np.where((cnt >= 50) & np.isfinite(beta), beta, 1.0)
    beta = np.clip(beta, 0.2, 3.0)

    resid = R - mk[:, None] * beta[None, :]

    # ---- volatility normalisers ----
    with np.errstate(invalid='ignore'):
        sig_r = np.nanstd(R[-120:], axis=0) * np.sqrt(252.0) if R.shape[0] >= 40 else np.full(m, np.nan)
        sig_e = np.nanstd(resid[-120:], axis=0) * np.sqrt(252.0) if R.shape[0] >= 40 else np.full(m, np.nan)
    sig_use = np.where(np.isfinite(sig_r) & (sig_r > 0.02), sig_r, 0.30)
    sig_euse = np.where(np.isfinite(sig_e) & (sig_e > 0.02), sig_e, 0.30)

    def _zrev(M, k, minc, sg):
        return -_rsum(M, k, minc) / (sg * np.sqrt(k / 252.0))

    rv21 = pd.Series(_zrev(R, 21, 10, sig_use), index=tickers, dtype=float)
    rv63 = pd.Series(_zrev(R, 63, 30, sig_use), index=tickers, dtype=float)
    re21 = pd.Series(_zrev(resid, 21, 10, sig_euse), index=tickers, dtype=float)
    re63 = pd.Series(_zrev(resid, 63, 30, sig_euse), index=tickers, dtype=float)

    vola = pd.Series(sig_r, index=tickers, dtype=float)
    qvol = (-vola).rank(pct=True, na_option='keep')

    mom = pd.Series(np.nan, index=tickers, dtype=float)
    if n >= 252:
        mom = sub.iloc[-21] / sub.iloc[-252] - 1.0
    qmom = mom.rank(pct=True, na_option='keep')

    comp = pd.DataFrame(index=tickers)
    comp['re21'] = re21.rank(pct=True, na_option='keep')
    comp['re63'] = re63.rank(pct=True, na_option='keep')
    comp['rv21'] = rv21.rank(pct=True, na_option='keep')
    comp['rv63'] = rv63.rank(pct=True, na_option='keep')
    comp['vol'] = qvol

    comp['re63'] = comp['re63'].fillna(comp['re21'])
    comp['rv63'] = comp['rv63'].fillna(comp['rv21'])

    wts = {'re21': 0.20, 're63': 0.15, 'rv21': 0.28, 'rv63': 0.22, 'vol': 0.15}
    num = pd.Series(0.0, index=tickers, dtype=float)
    cvg = pd.Series(0.0, index=tickers, dtype=float)
    for k, wk in wts.items():
        col = comp[k]
        ok = col.notna()
        num = num.add(col.fillna(0.0) * wk, fill_value=0.0)
        cvg = cvg.add(ok.astype(float) * wk, fill_value=0.0)

    score = num / cvg.where(cvg > 0)

    valid = sig_ok & latest_ok & liq_ok & last.notna() & (cvg >= 0.40)
    score = score[valid].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).dropna()
    if len(score) < 24:
        return _zeros(tickers)

    # ---- dispersion regime overlay ----
    disp_scale = 1.0
    try:
        with np.errstate(invalid='ignore'):
            cs = pd.Series(np.nanstd(R, axis=1), index=rets.index)
        cs = cs.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).dropna()
        if len(cs) >= 80:
            smooth = cs.rolling(21, min_periods=10).mean().dropna()
            if len(smooth) >= 40:
                cur = float(smooth.iloc[-1])
                window = smooth.tail(int(min(252, len(smooth))))
                pct = float((window.values <= cur).mean())
                disp_scale = 0.45 + 0.55 * max(0.0, min(1.0, pct))
    except Exception:
        disp_scale = 1.0

    n_side = int(min(50, len(score) // 2))
    if n_side < 12:
        return _zeros(tickers)

    ranked = score.sort_values(ascending=False)
    longs = list(ranked.index[:n_side])
    long_set = set(longs)

    # ---- short candidate pool: bottom of the score distribution ----
    pool_size = int(min(3 * n_side, max(0, len(ranked) - n_side)))
    if pool_size < n_side:
        pool = list(ranked.index[n_side:])
    else:
        pool = list(ranked.index[-pool_size:])
    pool = [t for t in pool if t not in long_set]

    if len(pool) > n_side:
        try:
            qs = qmom.reindex(pool)
            filt = [t for t in pool if not (pd.notna(qs.get(t, np.nan)) and float(qs.get(t, np.nan)) > 0.90)]
            if len(filt) >= n_side:
                pool = filt
        except Exception:
            pass

    # ---- beta-matched short selection ----
    betas = pd.Series(beta, index=tickers, dtype=float).fillna(1.0)
    if len(pool) < n_side:
        shorts = list(ranked.index[-n_side:])
    else:
        lb = betas.reindex(longs).fillna(1.0).values.astype(float)
        pb = betas.reindex(pool).fillna(1.0).values.astype(float)
        used = np.zeros(len(pool), dtype=bool)
        shorts = []
        for i in np.argsort(lb, kind='stable'):
            d = np.abs(pb - lb[i])
            d = np.where(used, np.inf, d)
            j = int(np.argmin(d))
            if not np.isfinite(d[j]):
                break
            used[j] = True
            shorts.append(pool[j])
        if len(shorts) < n_side:
            for j in range(len(pool)):
                if len(shorts) >= n_side:
                    break
                if not used[j]:
                    used[j] = True
                    shorts.append(pool[j])
        if len(shorts) < n_side:
            shorts = list(ranked.index[-n_side:])

    per_side = min(0.49, 0.02 * n_side) * disp_scale
    wgt = per_side / float(n_side)

    weights = pd.Series(0.0, index=tickers, dtype=float)
    weights.loc[longs] = wgt
    weights.loc[shorts] = -wgt

    weights = weights.clip(-0.02, 0.02)
    weights = weights.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], 0.0).fillna(0.0)
    return weights.reindex(tickers).fillna(0.0)

    ac = _get_df(history, 'adjusted_close')
    if ac is None:
        ac = _get_df(history, 'close')
    if ac is None or ac.empty:
        return zeros
    available = [c for c in cols if c in ac.columns]
    if not available:
        return zeros
    ac = ac.loc[:, available].sort_index().tail(320)
    if ac.empty:
        return zeros
    dates = ac.index
    last_date = dates[-1]
    wd = dates.weekday
    fridays = dates[wd == 4]
    sig_date = fridays[-1] if len(fridays) else last_date
    hist_ac = ac.loc[:sig_date]
    if len(hist_ac.index) < 6:
        hist_ac = ac
        sig_date = last_date
    if len(hist_ac.index) < 6:
        return zeros
    px = hist_ac.iloc[-1]
    ret5 = hist_ac.iloc[-1] / hist_ac.iloc[-6] - 1.0
    rets = hist_ac.pct_change().tail(20)
    vol = rets.std(ddof=0)
    elig = pd.Series(True, index=available)
    edf = _get_df(history, 'eligible')
    if edf is not None:
        ee = edf.reindex(columns=available).loc[:sig_date].tail(1)
        if len(ee.index) > 0:
            elig = ee.iloc[0].fillna(False).astype(bool)
    liq = pd.Series(np.nan, index=available)
    vdf = _get_df(history, 'volume')
    if vdf is not None:
        vv = vdf.reindex(columns=available).loc[:sig_date].tail(20)
        pp = hist_ac.tail(20)
        common = vv.index.intersection(pp.index)
        if len(common) > 0:
            dv = vv.loc[common].mul(pp.loc[common], axis=0)
            liq = dv.mean()
    base = (px.notna() & ret5.notna() & vol.notna() & (vol > 0) & (px > 1.0) & elig)
    base = base & np.isfinite(px) & np.isfinite(ret5) & np.isfinite(vol)
    if liq.notna().any():
        base = base & (liq.fillna(0.0) > 1e6)
    if int(base.sum()) < 10:
        base = (px.notna() & ret5.notna() & vol.notna() & (vol > 0) & (px > 0.5) & elig)
        base = base & np.isfinite(px) & np.isfinite(ret5) & np.isfinite(vol)
    candidates = [c for c in available if bool(base.get(c, False))]
    if len(candidates) < 2:
        return zeros
    r = ret5.loc[candidates].astype(float)
    long_order = sorted(candidates, key=lambda c: (float(r.get(c, np.nan)), c))
    short_order = sorted(candidates, key=lambda c: (-float(r.get(c, np.nan)), c))
    max_n = min(40, len(candidates) // 2)
    if max_n < 1:
        return zeros
    longs = long_order[:max_n]
    used = set(longs)
    shorts = [c for c in short_order if c not in used][:max_n]
    N = min(len(longs), len(shorts))
    if N < 1:
        return zeros
    longs = longs[:N]
    shorts = shorts[:N]
    w = float(min(0.5 / N, 0.02))
    weights = zeros.copy()
    for c in longs:
        if c in weights.index:
            weights.loc[c] = w
    for c in shorts:
        if c in weights.index:
            weights.loc[c] = -w
    net = float(weights.sum())
    if abs(net) > 1e-12:
        nz = weights.index[weights != 0.0]
        if len(nz) > 0:
            weights.loc[nz] -= net / len(nz)
    weights = weights.clip(-0.02, 0.02)
    gross = float(weights.abs().sum())
    if gross > 1.0:
        weights = weights * (1.0 / gross)
    return weights.fillna(0.0)

    dates = ac.index
    if len(dates) < 7:
        return zeros

    cdf = _df(history, 'close')
    if cdf is None:
        cdf = ac.copy()
    else:
        cdf = cdf.reindex(index=dates, columns=available)
        cdf = cdf.where(cdf.notna(), ac)

    vdf = _df(history, 'volume')
    adv = None
    if vdf is not None:
        vdf = vdf.reindex(index=dates, columns=available)
        dv = vdf.mul(cdf, axis=0)
        adv = dv.rolling(20, min_periods=10).median()

    edf = _df(history, 'eligible')
    if edf is not None:
        edf = edf.reindex(columns=available)
        edf = edf.reindex(index=dates).ffill()
    else:
        edf = pd.DataFrame(True, index=dates, columns=available)

    rets = ac / ac.shift(1) - 1.0
    vol = rets.rolling(60, min_periods=30).std(ddof=0)

    if len(weekly) == 0:

    pos = {d: i for i, d in enumerate(dates)}

    shorts = []
    target_n = 60

    for d in weekly:
        idx = pos.get(d, -1)
        if idx < 60:
            continue

        px = ac.iloc[idx]
        v = vol.iloc[idx]
        p_prev = ac.iloc[idx - 1]
        p5 = ac.iloc[idx - 5]
        pclose = cdf.iloc[idx]

        ret1 = px / p_prev - 1.0
        ret5 = px / p5 - 1.0
        raw = 0.8 * ret5 + 0.2 * ret1

        try:
            e = edf.loc[d]
        except Exception:
            e = pd.Series(False, index=available)
        e = e.reindex(available).fillna(False).astype(bool)

        base = px.notna() & p_prev.notna() & p5.notna() & v.notna() & raw.notna()

        if adv is not None:

        candidates = [c for c in available if bool(base.get(c, False))]
        if len(candidates) < 12:
            base = px.notna() & p_prev.notna() & p5.notna() & v.notna() & raw.notna()
            base = base & np.isfinite(raw) & np.isfinite(v)

        if len(new_shorts) > n_target:
            new_shorts = sorted(new_shorts, key=lambda c: (float(score[c]), c))[:n_target]

        held = set(new_longs) | set(new_shorts)

        for c in sorted_c:
            if len(new_longs) >= n_target:
                break
            if c in held:
                continue
            new_longs.append(c)
            held.add(c)

        for c in reversed(sorted_c):
            if len(new_shorts) >= n_target:

            if c in held:

            base = px.notna() & p_prev.notna() & p5.notna() & v.notna() & raw.notna()
            base = base & np.isfinite(raw) & np.isfinite(v)
            base = base & (v > 0.001) & (v < 0.15)

Prior rounds show that the short-horizon reversal signal has some gross alpha but is fragile after costs: the weekly risk-adjusted version was roughly flat out-of-sample with about 0.30 daily turnover, while the monthly trend/low-vol variant destroyed the reversal effect. The diagnosis is that the alpha is concentrated in sharp, high-volume overreactions and that turnover, not the weekly horizon itself, is the main problem. I will keep a Friday-to-Friday reversal clock but make three changes: (1) score reversal using both 5-day and 1-day risk-adjusted returns, intensified by recent relative volume, to focus on genuine overreaction rather than low-conviction drift; (2) use a wider one-week hysteresis band so existing longs are retained unless they fall below the 42nd percentile and existing shorts unless they rise above the 58th percentile, reducing churn while still rotating stale names; (3) keep a 25-name-per-side dollar-neutral book at 2% weights, with liquidity, price, volatility and extreme-move screens. The monthly trend-tilt variant destroyed the reversal effect, indicating the alpha horizon is days-to-weeks rather than months. I will therefore keep the validated risk-adjusted 5-day/1-day reversal score with volume confirmation and liquidity screens, but rebalance only every second ISO week (even Friday weeks) and widen the rank hysteresis band: retain an existing long while it stays above the 35th percentile and an existing short while it stays below the 65th. This directly halves the number of rebalance events while preserving the reversal extremes, and the wider buffer should further cut churn. import numpy as np
import pandas as pd


def _rank_centered(s):
    """Cross-sectional percentile rank mapped to [-0.5, 0.5]; NaN stays NaN."""
    s = pd.Series(s, dtype=float)
    s = s.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    return s.rank(pct=True) - 0.5


def _mom(px, skip, look):
    """Series of (price[t-skip] / price[t-skip-look] - 1) using positional rows."""
    n = px.shape[0]
    skip = int(min(skip, max(0, n - 2)))
    look = int(min(look, max(1, n - 1 - skip)))
    num = px.iloc[n - 1 - skip]
    den = px.iloc[n - 1 - skip - look]
    return num / den - 1.0

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

_STATE = {'month': None, 'weights': None, 'universe': None}


def _rank_df(df):
    return df.rank(axis=1, pct=True) - 0.5


def _factor_return(px, sig_df, hold=21, n_dates=12, top_frac=0.20):
    n = px.shape[0]
    if n < hold + 2:
        return 0.0
    last_j = n - 1 - hold
    first_j = max(hold, last_j - (n_dates - 1) * hold)
    vals = []
    for j in range(last_j, first_j - 1, -hold):
        s = sig_df.iloc[j]
        p0 = px.iloc[j]
        p1 = px.iloc[j + hold]
        v = s.notna() & p0.notna() & p1.notna() & (p0 > 0.0)
        if int(v.sum()) < 10:
            continue
        ss = s[v].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).dropna()
        if len(ss) < 10:
            continue
        k = int(len(ss) * top_frac)
        if k < 2:
            k = 2
        if k > len(ss) // 2:
            k = len(ss) // 2
        if k < 1:
            continue
        order = ss.sort_values(kind='mergesort')
        shorts = order.index[:k]
        longs = order.index[-k:]
        r = p1 / p0 - 1.0
        try:
            lr = float(r.loc[longs].mean())
            sr = float(r.loc[shorts].mean())
        except Exception:
            continue
        if np.isfinite(lr) and np.isfinite(sr):
            vals.append(lr - sr)
    if not vals:
        return 0.0
    return float(np.mean(vals))


def _compute_target(history, universe):
    universe = pd.Index(universe)
    zeros = pd.Series(0.0, index=universe, dtype=float)

    px = history.get('adjusted_close')
    if px is None or px.shape[1] == 0:
        px = history.get('close')
    if px is None or px.shape[1] == 0:
        return zeros
    try:
        px = px.reindex(columns=universe).astype(float)
    except Exception:
        return zeros

    n = px.shape[0]
    if n < 130:
        return zeros

    last = px.iloc[-1]
    valid = last.notna() & (last > 0.0) & (px.notna().sum() >= 120)
    if int(valid.sum()) < 10:

    ret = px / px.shift(1) - 1.0

    r6 = _rank_df(mom6)

    if n >= 22:
        r_mom = _factor_return(px, mom_sig)
        r_rev = _factor_return(px, rev_sig)
    else:

        r_rev = 0.0

    w_mom = float(np.tanh(r_mom / 0.01)) if np.isfinite(r_mom) else 0.0

    if abs(w_mom) + abs(w_rev) < 0.05:

    remain = target_side - sum(quotas.values())

        for b in sorted(range(5), key=lambda x: counts.get(x, 0), reverse=True):

            if cap > 0:

            if remain <= 0:

    shorts = []

        if q <= 0:
            continue
        idx = cand & (b_id == b)
        if int(idx.sum()) < 2:
            continue
        s = score[idx].sort_values(kind='mergesort')
        take = min(q, len(s) // 2)
        if take < 1:
            continue
        shorts.extend(s.index[:take].tolist())
        longs.extend(s.index[-take:].tolist())

    n_side = len(longs)
    if n_side < 2 or len(shorts) != n_side:
        return zeros

    w = min(0.5 / float(n_side), 0.02)
    weights = zeros.copy()
    weights.loc[longs] = w
    weights.loc[shorts] = -w
    weights = weights.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], 0.0).fillna(0.0).astype(float)
    weights = weights.clip(-0.02, 0.02)

    gross = float(weights.abs().sum())
    if gross > 1.0 + 1e-12:
        weights = weights * (1.0 / gross)

    net = float(weights.sum())
    if abs(net) > 0.01:
        weights = weights - net / max(1, len(universe))
        weights = weights.clip(-0.02, 0.02)

    return weights.astype(float)


def generate_weights(history, universe):
    universe = pd.Index(universe)
    zeros = pd.Series(0.0, index=universe, dtype=float)

    px = history.get('adjusted_close')
    if px is None or px.shape[1] == 0:

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

_STATE = {'month': None, 'weights': None, 'universe': None}


def _rank_centered(s):
    s = pd.Series(s, dtype=float).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    return s.rank(pct=True) - 0.5


def _compute(history, universe):
    universe = pd.Index(universe)
    zeros = pd.Series(0.0, index=universe, dtype=float)

    close = history.get('adjusted_close')
    if close is None or close.shape[1] == 0:
        close = history.get('close')
    if close is None or close.shape[1] == 0:
        return zeros
    try:
        close = close.reindex(columns=universe).astype(float)
    except Exception:
        return zeros

    openp = history.get('adjusted_open')
    if openp is None or openp.shape[1] == 0:
        openp = history.get('open')
    if openp is None or openp.shape[1] == 0:
        return zeros
    try:
        openp = openp.reindex(columns=universe).reindex(index=close.index).astype(float)
    except Exception:
        return zeros

    n = close.shape[0]
    if n < 90:
        return zeros

    last_c = close.iloc[-1]
    valid = last_c.notna() & (last_c > 0.0) & (close.notna().sum() >= 80)

    prev_close = close.shift(1)
    overnight = openp / prev_close - 1.0
    intraday = close / openp - 1.0
    overnight = overnight.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    intraday = intraday.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)

    window = min(60, n - 1)
    if window < 20:
        return zeros
    on_mean = overnight.tail(window).mean()
    id_mean = intraday.tail(window).mean()

    ret = close.pct_change().replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    vol = ret.tail(window).std()

    valid = valid & on_mean.notna() & id_mean.notna()
    if int(valid.sum()) < 12:
        return zeros

    volm = history.get('volume')
    if volm is not None:
        try:
            volm = volm.reindex(columns=universe).reindex(index=close.index).astype(float)
            dollar = (close * volm).tail(40).median()
            dollar = dollar.reindex(universe).fillna(0.0)
            liq = dollar > 2e6
            if int(liq.sum()) >= 15:
                valid = valid & liq
        except Exception:
            pass

    el = history.get('eligible')
    if el is not None:
        try:
            el = el.reindex(columns=universe).reindex(index=close.index)
            el_last = el.ffill().iloc[-1]
            flag = el_last.fillna(1.0).astype(float) > 0.5
            if int(flag.sum()) >= 15:
                valid = valid & flag
        except Exception:
            pass

    if int(valid.sum()) < 12:
        return zeros

    z_on = _rank_centered(on_mean)
    z_id = _rank_centered(id_mean)
    z_vol = _rank_centered(vol)

    score = 0.7 * z_on.fillna(0.0) - 0.7 * z_id.fillna(0.0) - 0.2 * z_vol.fillna(0.0)
    score = score.where(z_on.notna() & z_id.notna())
    score = score[valid].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).dropna()

    k = len(score)
    if k < 8:
        return zeros

    n_side = min(50, k // 2)
    if n_side < 2:
        return zeros

    order = score.sort_values(kind='mergesort')
    shorts = order.index[:n_side]
    longs = order.index[-n_side:]

    w = min(0.5 / float(n_side), 0.02)
    weights = zeros.copy()
    weights.loc[longs] = w
    weights.loc[shorts] = -w

    gross = float(weights.abs().sum())
    if gross > 1.0 + 1e-12:
        weights = weights * (1.0 / gross)

    weights = weights.clip(-0.02, 0.02)
    weights = weights.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], 0.0).fillna(0.0).astype(float)
    return weights

    n = close.shape[0]
    if n < 130:
        return zeros

    ret = close.pct_change()
    ret = ret.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    mkt = ret.mean(axis=1)

    win = 120
    R = ret.iloc[:-1].tail(win).fillna(0.0)
    m = mkt.iloc[:-1].tail(win).fillna(0.0)

        return zeros

    R_mean = R.mean()
    cov = ((R.sub(R_mean, axis=1)).mul(m - m_mean, axis=0)).sum(axis=0) / float(len(m))
    var = float(((m - m_mean) ** 2).sum()) / float(len(m))
    if not np.isfinite(var) or var <= 0.0:

    beta = cov / var
    beta = beta.reindex(universe).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd


def generate_weights(history, universe):
    universe = pd.Index(universe)
    zeros = pd.Series(0.0, index=universe, dtype=float)

    adj = history.get('adjusted_close')
    if adj is None or len(adj.index) == 0:
        return zeros

    dates = adj.index
    latest = dates[-1]

    # Rebalance on the last trading day of each week, so the new portfolio
    # is executed at the next open.  On other days hold the prior week's
    # signal to avoid unnecessary trading.
    try:
        current_week = latest.to_period('W')
        week_dates = dates[dates.to_period('W') == current_week]
        if len(week_dates) > 0 and latest == week_dates[-1]:
            rebal = latest
        else:
            prev_dates = dates[dates.to_period('W') < current_week]
            if len(prev_dates) == 0:
                return zeros
            rebal = prev_dates[-1]
    except Exception:
        rebal = latest

    adj_r = adj.loc[:rebal]
    if len(adj_r) < 6:
        return zeros

    tickers = universe.intersection(adj_r.columns)
    if len(tickers) == 0:
        return zeros

    adj_sub = adj_r[tickers]
    last = adj_sub.iloc[-1]

    # Five-session reversal.
    ret5 = last / adj_sub.iloc[-6] - 1.0

    # Intermediate trend: price relative to a 100-day mean.
    look = min(100, len(adj_sub))
    if look >= 40:
        sma = adj_sub.iloc[-look:].mean()
        trend = last / sma - 1.0
    else:
        trend = pd.Series(np.nan, index=tickers)

    # Liquidity filter using median 20-day dollar volume.
    vol = history.get('volume')
    if vol is not None:
        vol_r = vol.loc[:rebal].reindex(columns=tickers)
        dv = vol_r * adj_sub
        if len(dv) >= 20:
            liq = dv.iloc[-20:].median()
        else:
            liq = dv.median()
    else:
        liq = pd.Series(1.0, index=tickers)

    # Require both rebalance-date and current eligibility.

    shorts = score.index[-n_side:]

    # Guard against any accidental overlap (should not occur with unique scores).

        longs = longs[:n_side]
        shorts = shorts[-n_side:]

    total = min(0.5, 0.02 * n_side)
    w_long = total / n_side

    elig = history.get('eligible')

        else:

    valid = np.isfinite(last_close) & (last_close > 0)
    valid &= elig_last.to_numpy(dtype=bool)

    if V is not None and V.shape == C.shape:
        with np.errstate(all='ignore'):
            DV = CR * V
            med_dv = np.nanmedian(DV[-63:, :], axis=0)
        valid &= np.isfinite(med_dv) & (med_dv >= 5e5)

    with np.errstate(all='ignore'):
        valid &= np.isfinite(CR[-1, :]) & (CR[-1, :] >= 3.0)

    score = np.full(n_assets, np.nan, dtype=float)

            sub = C[-127:, :]

            sub = C[-64:, :]

    else:

            score = -rev

    score = np.where(valid & np.isfinite(score), score, np.nan)
    finite = np.isfinite(score)
    if finite.sum() < 2:
        return pd.Series(0.0, index=tickers, dtype=float)

    idx = np.where(finite)[0]
    scores = score[idx]
    order = np.argsort(scores)
    sorted_idx = idx[order]
    M = len(sorted_idx)
    N = min(50, M // 2)

    weights = np.zeros(n_assets, dtype=float)
    weights[longs] = w
    weights[shorts] = -w

    if len(adj_r) < 30:
        return zeros

    tickers = universe.intersection(adj_r.columns)
    if len(tickers) == 0:
        return zeros

    # Keep the computation window bounded for speed.
    win = adj_r.iloc[-300:].reindex(columns=tickers).ffill()
    n = len(win)
    if n < 25:
        return zeros

    last = win.iloc[-1]

    def get_ret(lookback, skip=21):
        end_idx = n - 1 - skip
        if end_idx < 1:
            return pd.Series(np.nan, index=tickers)
        start_idx = end_idx - lookback
        if start_idx < 0:
            start_idx = 0
        if start_idx >= end_idx:
            return pd.Series(np.nan, index=tickers)
        p0 = win.iloc[start_idx]
        p1 = win.iloc[end_idx]
        return p1 / p0 - 1.0

    r6 = get_ret(126, 21)
    r12 = get_ret(252, 21)

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd


def _field(history, names):
    for k in names:
        if k in history:
            df = history[k]
            if isinstance(df, pd.DataFrame) and df.shape[0] > 0:
                return df
    return None


def generate_weights(history, universe):
    universe = pd.Index(universe)
    if len(universe) == 0:
        return pd.Series(dtype=float)
    zeros = pd.Series(0.0, index=universe)

    px = _field(history, ('adjusted_close', 'adj_close', 'close'))
    if px is None:
        return zeros
    cols = [c for c in universe if c in px.columns]
    if len(cols) == 0:
        return zeros

    p = px[cols].copy()
    if len(p) < 60:
        return zeros

    tail_n = min(len(p), 320)
    pt = p.iloc[-tail_n:]
    arr = pt.to_numpy(dtype=float)
    n, k = arr.shape

    with np.errstate(all='ignore'):
        ret_all = arr[1:] / arr[:-1] - 1.0
    ret_all[~np.isfinite(ret_all)] = np.nan
    market = np.nanmean(ret_all, axis=1)
    market = np.where(np.isfinite(market), market, 0.0)

    edf = _field(history, ('eligible', 'tradable'))
    if edf is not None:
        try:
            last = edf.reindex(columns=cols).iloc[-1]
            elig = last.fillna(False).astype(bool).to_numpy()
        except Exception:
            elig = np.ones(k, dtype=bool)
    else:
        elig = np.ones(k, dtype=bool)

    liq = np.ones(k, dtype=bool)
    vdf = _field(history, ('volume', 'vol'))
    if vdf is not None:
        try:
            v = vdf.reindex(index=pt.index, columns=cols).to_numpy(dtype=float)
            cdf = _field(history, ('close', 'adjusted_close', 'adj_close'))
            if cdf is not None:
                c = cdf.reindex(index=pt.index, columns=cols).to_numpy(dtype=float)
            else:
                c = arr
            dv = v * c
            if len(dv) >= 20:
                adv = np.nanmean(dv[-20:], axis=0)
            else:
                adv = np.nanmean(dv, axis=0)
            finite = np.isfinite(adv)
            liq[finite] = adv[finite] > 1e6
        except Exception:
            liq = np.ones(k, dtype=bool)

    tnames = []
    scores = []
    trends = []
    vols = []
    jj = []

    for j, t in enumerate(cols):
        s = arr[:, j]
        valid = np.isfinite(s) & (s > 0.0)
        if not valid[-1]:
            continue

        with np.errstate(all='ignore'):
            r = s[1:] / s[:-1] - 1.0
        r[~np.isfinite(r)] = np.nan

        y = r[-252:]
        x = market[-252:]
        mask = np.isfinite(y) & np.isfinite(x)
        if mask.sum() >= 60:
            yv = y[mask]
            xv = x[mask]
            xm = xv.mean()
            ym = yv.mean()
            var = np.mean((xv - xm) ** 2)
            if var > 0.0:
                beta = np.mean((xv - xm) * (yv - ym)) / var
            else:
                beta = 1.0
        else:
            beta = 1.0

        resid = r - beta * market
        resid[~np.isfinite(resid)] = np.nan

        look = 126
        skip = 21
        if len(resid) < look + skip:
            look = 63
            if len(resid) < look + skip:
                look = 21
                if len(resid) < look + skip:
                    continue

        window = resid[-(skip + look):-skip] if skip > 0 else resid[-look:]
        window = window[np.isfinite(window)]
        if len(window) < max(8, look // 3):
            continue
        cum = float(np.sum(window))

        rv = resid[-252:]
        rv = rv[np.isfinite(rv)]
        if len(rv) >= 20:
            vol = float(np.std(rv, ddof=1) * np.sqrt(252.0))
        else:
            vol = np.nan
        if not np.isfinite(vol) or vol <= 0.0:
            vol = 0.20
        vol = max(vol, 0.05)

        score = cum / (vol * np.sqrt(look / 252.0))

        sv = s[valid]
        ma_n = min(200, len(sv))
        if ma_n > 0:
            ma = float(np.mean(sv[-ma_n:]))
            trend = s[-1] / ma - 1.0 if ma > 0.0 else 0.0
        else:
            trend = 0.0

        tnames.append(t)
        scores.append(score)
        trends.append(trend)
        vols.append(vol)
        jj.append(j)

    if len(tnames) < 6:
        return zeros

    scores = np.asarray(scores, dtype=float)
    trends = np.asarray(trends, dtype=float)

    def _z(a):
        a = np.asarray(a, dtype=float)
        med = np.nanmedian(a)
        mad = np.nanmedian(np.abs(a - med))
        if mad > 0.0:
            z = (a - med) / (1.4826 * mad)
        else:
            sd = np.nanstd(a)
            if sd > 0.0:
                z = (a - med) / sd
            else:
                z = np.zeros_like(a)
        z[~np.isfinite(z)] = 0.0
        return z

    zs = _z(scores)
    zt = _z(trends)
    comp = zs + 0.4 * zt

    for i, j in enumerate(jj):
        if not bool(elig[j]) or not bool(liq[j]):
            comp[i] = np.nan

    keep = np.isfinite(comp)
    if keep.sum() < 6:
        return zeros

    kept_names = [tnames[i] for i in range(len(tnames)) if keep[i]]
    comp = comp[keep]

    order = np.argsort(comp)
    n_side = min(30, len(comp) // 2)
    if n_side < 1:
        return zeros

    shorts = [kept_names[i] for i in order[:n_side]]
    longs = [kept_names[i] for i in order[-n_side:]]

    short_set = set(shorts)
    longs = [x for x in longs if x not in short_set]
    long_set = set(longs)
    shorts = [x for x in shorts if x not in long_set]

    if n_side < 1:
        return zeros
    longs = longs[:n_side]
    shorts = shorts[:n_side]

    w = min(0.02, 0.98 / (2.0 * n_side))
    weights = zeros.copy()
    for t in longs:
        weights.loc[t] = w
    for t in shorts:
        weights.loc[t] = -w

    return weights.fillna(0.0)

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def generate_weights(history, universe):
    # Extract adjusted close and volume
    adj = history['adjusted_close']
    vol = history['volume']
    # Align to universe columns
    tickers = universe.intersection(adj.columns)
    if len(tickers) == 0:
        return pd.Series(0.0, index=universe)
    adj = adj[tickers]
    vol = vol[tickers]
    idx = adj.index
    if len(idx) == 0:
        return pd.Series(0.0, index=universe)
    last_date = idx[-1]
    # Find last rebalance date: first trading day of month
    periods = idx.to_period('M')
    first_mask = ~periods.duplicated(keep='first')
    rebal_dates = idx[first_mask]
    if len(rebal_dates) == 0:
        return pd.Series(0.0, index=universe)
    rebal_date = rebal_dates[-1]
    # Slice data up to rebal_date
    adj_r = adj.loc[:rebal_date]
    vol_r = vol.loc[:rebal_date]
    n = len(adj_r)
    if n < 2:
        return pd.Series(0.0, index=universe)
    ret = adj_r.pct_change()
    # Momentum: 120-day return skipping last 5 days
    if n >= 126:
        mom = adj_r.iloc[-6] / adj_r.iloc[-126] - 1.0
    else:
        mom = pd.Series(np.nan, index=tickers)
    # Short-term reversal: 5-day return
    if n >= 6:
        ret5 = adj_r.iloc[-1] / adj_r.iloc[-6] - 1.0
    else:
        ret5 = pd.Series(np.nan, index=tickers)
    # Volatility: std of daily returns over last 60 days
    if n >= 60:
        vol60 = ret.iloc[-60:].std()
    else:
        vol60 = ret.std()
    # Dollar volume: median over last 20 days
    if n >= 20:
        dv = (adj_r.iloc[-20:] * vol_r.iloc[-20:]).median()
    else:
        dv = (adj_r * vol_r).median()
    # Build dataframe
    df = pd.DataFrame({'mom': mom, 'ret5': ret5, 'vol': vol60, 'dv': dv})
    df = df.dropna(subset=['mom', 'ret5', 'vol', 'dv'])
    df = df[df['vol'] > 0]
    if len(df) < 10:
        return pd.Series(0.0, index=universe)
    # Liquidity filter: keep top 80% by dollar volume
    dv_cut = df['dv'].quantile(0.2)
    df = df[df['dv'] >= dv_cut]
    if len(df) < 10:
        return pd.Series(0.0, index=universe)
    # Risk-adjusted momentum
    df['mom_adj'] = df['mom'] / df['vol']
    # Composite score
    def zscore(s):
        std = s.std(ddof=0)
        if std == 0 or np.isnan(std):
            return s * 0.0
        return (s - s.mean()) / std
    df['z_mom'] = zscore(df['mom_adj'])
    df['z_ret5'] = zscore(df['ret5'])
    df['score'] = df['z_mom'] - 0.5 * df['z_ret5']
    # Select top and bottom
    k = min(50, len(df) // 2)
    if k < 1:
        return pd.Series(0.0, index=universe)
    df_sorted = df.sort_values('score', ascending=False)
    long_tickers = df_sorted.index[:k]
    short_tickers = df_sorted.index[-k:]
    # Weight per position
    w = min(0.02, 1.0 / (2.0 * k))
    weights = pd.Series(0.0, index=universe)
    weights.loc[long_tickers] = w
    weights.loc[short_tickers] = -w
    return weights

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd


def _cs_rank(x):
    """Cross-sectional rank mapped to (-0.5, 0.5), ties averaged."""
    s = pd.Series(np.asarray(x, dtype=float))
    r = s.rank(method='average').to_numpy()
    n = len(r)
    if n == 0:
        return r
    return r / n - 0.5


def generate_weights(history, universe):
    uni = pd.Index(universe)
    n = len(uni)
    if n == 0:
        return pd.Series(dtype=float)

    weights = pd.Series(0.0, index=uni, dtype=float)

    try:
        adj = history['adjusted_close']
    except Exception:
        return weights
    if adj is None or not hasattr(adj, 'shape') or adj.shape[0] < 65 or n < 6:
        return weights

    adj = adj.reindex(columns=uni)
    px = adj.to_numpy(dtype=float)
    if px.ndim != 2 or px.shape[1] != n:
        return weights

    last = px[-1]

    with np.errstate(invalid='ignore', divide='ignore'):
        r5 = last / px[-6] - 1.0
        r60 = last / px[-61] - 1.0
        recent = px[-21:]
        rets = recent[1:] / recent[:-1] - 1.0

    finite_rets = np.isfinite(rets)
    cnt = finite_rets.sum(axis=0)
    with np.errstate(invalid='ignore'):
        vol = np.nanstd(rets, axis=0)

    valid = (np.isfinite(last) & (last > 0.0) & np.isfinite(r5)
             & np.isfinite(r60) & np.isfinite(vol) & (vol > 0.0)
             & (cnt >= 15))

    try:
        elig_raw = history['eligible'].reindex(columns=uni).iloc[-1]
        elig = pd.to_numeric(elig_raw, errors='coerce').fillna(1.0).to_numpy(dtype=float) > 0.0
        valid = valid & elig
    except Exception:
        pass

    idx = np.flatnonzero(valid)
    if len(idx) < 6:
        return weights

    r5v = r5[idx]
    r60v = r60[idx]
    volv = vol[idx]

    rank_r5 = _cs_rank(r5v)
    rank_vol = _cs_rank(volv)
    rank_mom = _cs_rank(r60v)

    # short-horizon reversal (short recent winners), low-vol tilt, light momentum
    score = -1.0 * rank_r5 - 0.75 * rank_vol + 0.40 * rank_mom

    order = np.argsort(-score, kind='mergesort')
    k = min(30, len(idx) // 2)
    if k < 3:
        return weights

    long_pos = order[:k]
    short_pos = order[-k:]

    target_gross_per_side = 0.45
    w = min(0.02, target_gross_per_side / k)

    long_tickers = idx[long_pos]
    short_tickers = idx[short_pos]

    vals = np.zeros(n, dtype=float)
    vals[long_tickers] = w
    vals[short_tickers] = -w

    weights = pd.Series(vals, index=uni, dtype=float)
    weights = weights.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], 0.0).fillna(0.0)
    return weights

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

MAX_W = 0.02
N_SIDE = 25
LAGS = (0, 3, 6, 9)
LAG_W = (0.40, 0.30, 0.20, 0.10)


def _rank_pct(s, mask):
    return s.where(mask).rank(pct=True)


def _score_at(ac, resid, vol60_full, end):
    """Composite reversal score using data strictly up to row `end` (inclusive)."""
    if end is None or end < 30:
        return None
    # recent idiosyncratic return, skipping the most recent session
    res5 = resid.iloc[max(0, end - 5):end].sum()
    res21 = resid.iloc[max(0, end - 21):end].sum()
    i0 = max(0, end - 21)
    i12 = max(0, end - 252)
    p0 = ac.iloc[i0]
    p12 = ac.iloc[i12]
    mom12 = p0.div(p12) - 1.0
    v60 = vol60_full.iloc[end]
    mask = (res5.notna() & res21.notna() & mom12.notna() &
            v60.notna() & np.isfinite(v60) & (v60 > 0))
    if int(mask.sum()) < 20:
        return None
    score = (-0.45 * _rank_pct(res5, mask)
             - 0.35 * _rank_pct(res21, mask)
             - 0.15 * _rank_pct(mom12, mask))
    return score.where(mask)


def generate_weights(history, universe):
    universe = pd.Index(universe)
    zero = pd.Series(0.0, index=universe, dtype=float)
    if len(universe) == 0:
        return zero

    ac = history.get('adjusted_close')
    if ac is None:
        ac = history.get('close')
    if ac is None:
        return zero
    ac = ac.reindex(columns=universe).astype(float)
    T = len(ac)
    if T < 45:
        return zero

    vol = history.get('volume')
    if vol is not None:
        vol = vol.reindex(columns=universe).astype(float)

    ret = ac.pct_change()
    mkt = ret.mean(axis=1)
    resid = ret.sub(mkt, axis=0)
    vol60_full = ret.rolling(60, min_periods=20).std()

    last = T - 1

    # ---- lagged blend of the composite reversal score ----
    blend = pd.Series(0.0, index=universe, dtype=float)
    wsum = 0.0
    for lag, w in zip(LAGS, LAG_W):
        s = _score_at(ac, resid, vol60_full, last - lag)
        if s is None:
            continue
        centered = (s - s.median()).fillna(0.0)
        blend = blend + w * centered
        wsum += w
    if wsum <= 0:
        return zero
    blend = blend / wsum

    # ---- tradability filters evaluated at the decision close ----
    price_last = ac.iloc[last]
    v60_now = vol60_full.iloc[last]
    mask = (price_last.notna() & (price_last > 5.0) &
            v60_now.notna() & np.isfinite(v60_now) & (v60_now > 0))

    dv_last = None
    if vol is not None:
        dv_last = (ac * vol).rolling(20, min_periods=5).mean().iloc[last]
        mask = mask & dv_last.notna() & (dv_last > 0)
        if int(mask.sum()) > 50:
            thr = dv_last.where(mask).quantile(0.20)
            if np.isfinite(thr):
                mask = mask & (dv_last >= thr)

    elig = history.get('eligible')
    if elig is not None:
        e = elig.reindex(columns=universe)
        if len(e) > 0:
            mask = mask & e.iloc[-1].fillna(False).astype(bool)

    # volatility cap: drop the most volatile quintile on both legs
    vv = v60_now.where(mask)
    if int(vv.notna().sum()) >= 20:
        cap = vv.quantile(0.80)
        if np.isfinite(cap):
            mask = mask & (v60_now <= cap)

    # no parabolic names (limits short-leg squeeze risk)
    i21 = max(0, last - 21)
    r21 = price_last.div(ac.iloc[i21]) - 1.0
    mask = mask & r21.notna() & (r21 < 1.0)

    s = blend.where(mask).dropna()
    if len(s) < 4:
        return zero

    order = s.sort_values(ascending=False)
    n_side = min(N_SIDE, len(order) // 2)
    if n_side < 1:
        return zero

    longs = order.index[:n_side]
    shorts = order.index[-n_side:]
    w_side = min(MAX_W, 0.5 / n_side)

    weights = pd.Series(0.0, index=universe, dtype=float)
    weights.loc[longs] = w_side
    weights.loc[shorts] = -w_side
    weights = weights.clip(-MAX_W, MAX_W)
    weights = weights.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], 0.0).fillna(0.0)
    return weights

import pandas as pd


def _cs_rank(arr):
    """Cross-sectional rank mapped to (-0.5, 0.5), average ties."""
    s = pd.Series(np.asarray(arr, dtype=float))
    r = s.rank(method='average').to_numpy(dtype=float)
    n = len(r)
    if n == 0:
        return r
    return r / n - 0.5


def generate_weights(history, universe):
    uni = pd.Index(universe)
    n = len(uni)
    if n == 0:
        return pd.Series(dtype=float)

    weights = pd.Series(0.0, index=uni, dtype=float)

    # Pull adjusted close prices; bail out defensively on any data problem.
    try:
        adj = history['adjusted_close']
    except Exception:
        return weights
    if adj is None:
        return weights
    try:
        if adj.shape[0] < 65 or n < 6:
            return weights
        adj = adj.reindex(columns=uni)
    except Exception:
        return weights

    try:
        px = adj.to_numpy(dtype=float)
    except Exception:
        return weights
    if px.ndim != 2 or px.shape[1] != n or px.shape[0] < 65:
        return weights

    last = px[-1]

    with np.errstate(invalid='ignore', divide='ignore'):
        r5 = last / px[-6] - 1.0
        r60 = last / px[-61] - 1.0
        recent = px[-21:]
        rets = recent[1:] / recent[:-1] - 1.0
        vol = np.nanstd(rets, axis=0)

    finite_rets = np.isfinite(rets)
    cnt = finite_rets.sum(axis=0)

    valid = (np.isfinite(last) & (last > 0.0)
             & np.isfinite(r5) & np.isfinite(r60)
             & np.isfinite(vol) & (vol > 0.0)
             & (cnt >= 15))

    # Respect the tradability flag if present.
    try:
        elig_raw = history['eligible'].reindex(columns=uni).iloc[-1]
        elig = pd.to_numeric(elig_raw, errors='coerce').fillna(1.0).to_numpy(dtype=float) > 0.0
        valid = valid & elig
    except Exception:
        pass

    idx = np.flatnonzero(valid)
    if len(idx) < 6:
        return weights

    r5v = r5[idx]
    r60v = r60[idx]
    volv = vol[idx]

    rank_r5 = _cs_rank(r5v)
    rank_vol = _cs_rank(volv)
    rank_mom = _cs_rank(r60v)

    # Short-horizon reversal (short recent winners), low-vol tilt, light momentum.
    score = -1.0 * rank_r5 - 0.75 * rank_vol + 0.40 * rank_mom

    order = np.argsort(-score, kind='mergesort')
    k = min(30, len(idx) // 2)
    if k < 3:
        return weights

    long_pos = order[:k]
    short_pos = order[-k:]

    target_gross_per_side = 0.45
    w = min(0.02, target_gross_per_side / k)

    long_tickers = idx[long_pos]
    short_tickers = idx[short_pos]

    vals = np.zeros(n, dtype=float)
    vals[long_tickers] = w
    vals[short_tickers] = -w

    weights = pd.Series(vals, index=uni, dtype=float)
    weights = weights.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], 0.0).fillna(0.0)
    return weights

    else:
        p_start = C.iloc[0]
    if C.shape[0] >= 22:
        p_end = C.iloc[-22]
    else:
        p_end = last

    tail = rets.tail(60)

    valid_vol_days = tail.notna().sum()

    volume = history.get('volume')

        except Exception:

    mask &= last > 5.0

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd


def _pct_rank(x, mask):
    x = x.reindex(mask.index).astype(float)
    x = x.where(mask, np.nan)
    if x.notna().sum() < 2:
        return pd.Series(0.5, index=mask.index)
    med = x.median()
    x = x.fillna(med)
    return x.rank(method='average', pct=True)


def generate_weights(history, universe):
    u = pd.Index(universe)
    zero = pd.Series(0.0, index=u, dtype=float)
    try:
        adj_full = history.get('adjusted_close')
        if adj_full is None:
            adj_full = history.get('close')
        if adj_full is None or adj_full.shape[0] < 50:
            return zero

        adj_full = adj_full.reindex(columns=u).astype(float)
        idx = adj_full.index
        current = idx[-1]
        prior_mask = (idx.year < current.year) | ((idx.year == current.year) & (idx.month < current.month))
        if not prior_mask.any():
            return zero

        sig_date = idx[prior_mask][-1]
        sig_loc = int(idx.get_indexer([sig_date])[0])
        if sig_loc < 40:
            return zero

        adj = adj_full.iloc[:sig_loc + 1]
        last = adj.iloc[-1]
        valid = last.notna() & np.isfinite(last) & (last > 1.0)
        valid = valid & (adj.notna().sum() >= 80)

        elig_full = history.get('eligible')
        if elig_full is not None:
            try:
                elig = elig_full.reindex(index=adj.index, columns=u).astype(float)
                e = elig.iloc[-1]
                valid = valid & (e.fillna(0.0) > 0)
            except Exception:
                pass

        if int(valid.sum()) < 30:
            return zero

        vol_full = history.get('volume')
        if vol_full is not None:
            try:
                vdf = vol_full.reindex(index=adj.index, columns=u).astype(float)
                dv = adj * vdf
                liq = dv.iloc[-min(60, len(dv)):].median()
            except Exception:
                liq = pd.Series(0.0, index=u)
        else:
            liq = pd.Series(0.0, index=u)
        liq = liq.reindex(u).astype(float).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).fillna(0.0)

        rets = adj / adj.shift(1) - 1.0
        rets = rets.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)

        liq_valid = liq.where(valid)
        n_valid = int(valid.sum())
        top_n = min(300, n_valid)
        if top_n < 20:
            return zero
        liq_cut = liq_valid.nlargest(top_n).min()
        pool = valid & (liq >= liq_cut)
        if int(pool.sum()) < 20:
            return zero

        look = min(120, len(rets) - 1)
        if look < 40:
            return zero

        R = rets.iloc[-look:]
        M = R.values
        m = np.nanmean(M, axis=1)
        m = np.where(np.isfinite(m), m, 0.0)
        var_m = np.nanvar(m)
        beta = np.full(M.shape[1], np.nan)
        if var_m > 0.0:
            for j in range(M.shape[1]):
                x = M[:, j]
                msk = np.isfinite(x)
                if int(msk.sum()) >= 40:
                    xv = x[msk]
                    mv = m[msk]
                    xm = xv - xv.mean()
                    mm = mv - mv.mean()
                    den = float(np.dot(mm, mm))
                    if den > 0.0:
                        beta[j] = float(np.dot(xm, mm) / den)

        beta_s = pd.Series(beta, index=u)
        beta_s = beta_s.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).fillna(1.0).clip(-1.0, 3.0)

        market_full = rets.mean(axis=1)
        R2 = rets.iloc[-look:]
        m2 = market_full.iloc[-look:].values
        m2 = np.where(np.isfinite(m2), m2, 0.0)
        resid = R2.values - m2[:, None] * beta_s.values[None, :]
        resid_vol = np.nanstd(resid, axis=0)
        resid_vol_s = pd.Series(resid_vol, index=u)
        resid_vol_s = resid_vol_s.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        resid_vol_s = resid_vol_s.where(resid_vol_s > 1e-8, np.nan)

        def _resid_sum(k):
            k = min(k, len(rets))
            rr = rets.iloc[-k:]
            mm = market_full.iloc[-k:].values
            mm = np.where(np.isfinite(mm), mm, 0.0)
            res = rr.values - mm[:, None] * beta_s.values[None, :]
            return pd.Series(np.nansum(res, axis=0), index=u)

        r21 = _resid_sum(21)
        r5 = _resid_sum(5)
        r21z = r21 / (resid_vol_s * np.sqrt(21.0))
        r5z = r5 / (resid_vol_s * np.sqrt(5.0))
        r21z = r21z.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        r5z = r5z.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)

        pool = pool & r21z.notna() & r5z.notna()
        if int(pool.sum()) < 20:
            return zero

        vol60 = rets.iloc[-min(60, len(rets)):].std()
        rk21 = _pct_rank(r21z, pool)
        rk5 = _pct_rank(r5z, pool)
        rkv = _pct_rank(vol60, pool)
        rkl = _pct_rank(liq, pool)

        score = (1.0 - rk21) + 0.5 * (1.0 - rk5) - 0.15 * rkv + 0.05 * rkl
        score = score.where(pool, np.nan)

        beta_pool = beta_s.where(pool)
        brank = beta_pool.rank(method='first')
        nb = int(pool.sum())
        q = np.ceil(brank / float(nb) * 5.0).clip(1, 5)

        long_candidates = []
        short_candidates = []
        for b in range(1, 6):
            members = score[(q == b) & pool].dropna()
            if len(members) < 2:
                continue
            n_side = min(6, len(members) // 2)
            if n_side < 1:
                continue
            ordered = members.sort_values(ascending=False)
            long_candidates.extend(ordered.index[:n_side].tolist())
            short_candidates.extend(ordered.index[-n_side:].tolist())

        long_candidates = list(dict.fromkeys(long_candidates))
        short_candidates = list(dict.fromkeys(short_candidates))
        long_set = set(long_candidates)
        short_candidates = [t for t in short_candidates if t not in long_set]

        if len(long_candidates) < 5 or len(short_candidates) < 5:
            return zero

        long_sorted = sorted(
            long_candidates,
            key=lambda t: score.loc[t] if pd.notna(score.loc[t]) else -1e9,
            reverse=True,
        )
        short_sorted = sorted(
            short_candidates,
            key=lambda t: score.loc[t] if pd.notna(score.loc[t]) else 1e9,
        )

        k = min(len(long_sorted), len(short_sorted), 30)
        if k < 5:
            return zero

        w = min(0.02, 0.5 / float(k))
        out = zero.copy()
        out.loc[long_sorted[:k]] = w
        out.loc[short_sorted[:k]] = -w
        out = out.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], 0.0).fillna(0.0).clip(-0.02, 0.02)
        return out
    except Exception:
        return zero

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

_CACHE = {}


def _rank(x):
    s = pd.Series(np.asarray(x, dtype=float))
    s = s.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    if s.notna().sum() == 0:
        return np.full(len(s), 0.5)
    return s.rank(pct=True).fillna(0.5).to_numpy()


def generate_weights(history, universe):
    tickers = pd.Index(universe)
    n = len(tickers)
    if n == 0:
        return pd.Series(dtype=float)
    zero = pd.Series(0.0, index=tickers)

    adj_full = history.get('adjusted_close')
    if adj_full is None:
        adj_full = history.get('close')
    if adj_full is None or adj_full.shape[0] < 2:
        return zero

    dates = adj_full.index
    y = dates.year.to_numpy()
    m = dates.month.to_numpy()
    change = (y[1:] != y[:-1]) | (m[1:] != m[:-1])
    completed = np.where(change)[0]
    if len(completed) == 0:
        return zero
    pos = int(completed[-1])
    if pos < 126:
        return zero

    key = (dates[pos], tuple(tickers))
    cached = _CACHE.get(key)
    if cached is not None:
        return pd.Series(cached.copy(), index=tickers)

    start = max(0, pos + 1 - 300)
    adj_df = adj_full.iloc[start:pos + 1].reindex(columns=tickers)
    idx = adj_df.index

    close_full = history.get('close')
    if close_full is None:
        close_df = adj_df
    else:
        close_df = close_full.reindex(index=idx, columns=tickers)

    vol_full = history.get('volume')
    if vol_full is None:
        vol_df = pd.DataFrame(1.0, index=idx, columns=tickers)
    else:
        vol_df = vol_full.reindex(index=idx, columns=tickers)

    elig_full = history.get('eligible')
    if elig_full is not None:
        elig_last = elig_full.reindex(index=idx, columns=tickers).iloc[-1]
        eligible = elig_last.fillna(False).astype(bool).to_numpy()
    else:
        eligible = np.ones(n, dtype=bool)

    adj = adj_df.to_numpy(dtype=float)
    close = close_df.to_numpy(dtype=float)
    volume = vol_df.to_numpy(dtype=float)
    L = adj.shape[0]
    if L < 126:
        return zero

    last_adj = adj[-1]
    valid_price = np.isfinite(last_adj) & (last_adj > 0)
    if not np.any(valid_price):
        return zero

    with np.errstate(divide='ignore', invalid='ignore'):
        p1 = adj[-6]
        p0 = adj[-126] if L >= 126 else adj[0]
        mom = p1 / p0 - 1.0
        rev = adj[-1] / adj[-6] - 1.0
        ret = adj[1:] / adj[:-1] - 1.0

    mom = np.where(np.isfinite(mom), mom, np.nan)
    rev = np.where(np.isfinite(rev), rev, np.nan)
    ret = np.where(np.isfinite(ret), ret, np.nan)

    if ret.shape[0] >= 2:
        vol_tail = ret[-min(60, ret.shape[0]):]
        vol = np.nanstd(vol_tail, axis=0)
    else:
        vol = np.full(n, np.nan)
    vol = np.where(np.isfinite(vol), vol, np.nan)

    close_arr = np.where(np.isfinite(close), close, adj)
    dollar = close_arr * volume
    liq_tail = dollar[-min(60, L):]
    if liq_tail.shape[0] > 0:
        liq = np.nanmedian(liq_tail, axis=0)
    else:
        liq = np.zeros(n)
    liq = np.where(np.isfinite(liq), liq, 0.0)

    mask = eligible & valid_price & np.isfinite(mom) & np.isfinite(rev) & np.isfinite(vol) & (vol > 1e-8) & (liq >= 5e5)
    if np.sum(mask) < 10:
        mask = eligible & valid_price & np.isfinite(mom) & np.isfinite(rev)
    if np.sum(mask) < 4:
        mask = eligible & valid_price & np.isfinite(mom)
    if np.sum(mask) < 2:
        return zero

    cand_idx = np.where(mask)[0]
    n_cand = len(cand_idx)
    n_side = min(50, n_cand // 2)
    if n_side < 1:
        return zero

    r_mom = _rank(mom[cand_idx])
    r_rev = _rank(rev[cand_idx])
    r_vol = _rank(vol[cand_idx])
    r_liq = _rank(liq[cand_idx])

    score = 0.55 * r_mom + 0.15 * r_liq - 0.20 * r_rev - 0.20 * r_vol
    order = np.argsort(-score, kind='mergesort')
    long_sel = cand_idx[order[:n_side]]
    short_sel = cand_idx[order[-n_side:]]

    w = min(0.02, 0.5 / n_side)
    weights = np.zeros(n, dtype=float)
    weights[long_sel] = w
    weights[short_sel] = -w
    weights = np.nan_to_num(weights, nan=0.0, posinf=0.0, neginf=0.0)
    weights = np.clip(weights, -0.02, 0.02)

    if len(_CACHE) >= 8:
        first_key = None
        for k in _CACHE:
            first_key = k
            break
        if first_key is not None:
            _CACHE.pop(first_key, None)
    _CACHE[key] = weights.copy()

    return pd.Series(weights, index=tickers)

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np


def generate_weights(history, universe):
    universe = pd.Index(universe)
    zeros = pd.Series(0.0, index=universe, dtype=float)

    try:
        adj_close = history['adjusted_close']
    except Exception:
        return zeros

    if adj_close is None or adj_close.shape[0] == 0 or adj_close.shape[1] == 0:
        return zeros

    dates = adj_close.index
    if len(dates) < 61:
        return zeros

    current_date = dates[-1]

    # Last month-end trading date in the available history.
    s = pd.Series(dates, index=dates)
    month_ends = s.groupby([dates.year, dates.month]).max()
    candidates = month_ends[month_ends <= current_date]
    rebal_date = current_date if len(candidates) == 0 else candidates.iloc[-1]

    idx = adj_close.index.get_loc(rebal_date)
    if idx < 60:
        return zeros

    close_hist = adj_close.iloc[:idx + 1]
    prices = close_hist.iloc[-61:]
    rets = prices.pct_change().iloc[1:]
    vol = rets.std(axis=0, ddof=1) * np.sqrt(252.0)

    vol_hist = history['volume'].iloc[:idx + 1].iloc[-20:]
    close_20 = close_hist.iloc[-20:]
    dollar = (close_20 * vol_hist).mean(axis=0)
    price = close_hist.iloc[-1]

    if 'eligible' in history:
        try:
            elig = history['eligible'].iloc[idx]
        except Exception:
            elig = pd.Series(True, index=adj_close.columns)
    else:
        elig = pd.Series(True, index=adj_close.columns)

    v = vol.reindex(universe)
    d = dollar.reindex(universe)
    p = price.reindex(universe)
    e = elig.reindex(universe).fillna(False).astype(bool)

    mask = (
        v.notna()
        & d.notna()
        & p.notna()
        & (v > 0.0)
        & (p > 1.0)
        & (d > 1_000_000.0)
        & e
    )

    candidates = universe[mask]
    if len(candidates) < 10:
        return zeros

    n_side = min(25, len(candidates) // 2)
    if n_side < 5:
        return zeros

    w = min(0.02, 0.5 / n_side)
    vals = v.loc[candidates].values
    order = np.argsort(vals)
    sorted_cands = candidates[order]

    long_names = sorted_cands[:n_side]
    short_names = sorted_cands[-n_side:]

    weights = pd.Series(0.0, index=universe, dtype=float)
    weights.loc[long_names] = w
    weights.loc[short_names] = -w

    weights = weights.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], 0.0).fillna(0.0)
    weights = weights.clip(-0.02, 0.02)

    gross = weights.abs().sum()
    if gross > 1.0:
        weights = weights / gross

    return weights
